name: assembly-newsh2-245
summary: Purple eye fortress, 72 x 28 px from three 2x2 pieces, mirror symmetric about column 36: a purple armoured block set into grey rock. In the middle a big dark blue glass eye sits in a raised round collar; under it two slanted blue capsule lights and a small barred grille; a large raised octagonal armour plate on each side; pale vertical beams between the plates and the middle; a band of raised panels along the top and bottom edges; grey boulders with sand-coloured stones fill both ends. Shape language: hard chamfered purple plating stacked in layers (plates higher than the beams and bands), with round glass parts (the eye ball and the capsules) and lumpy matte rock.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours

ringed by a thin blue-grey rim where it meets the collar
features.note: Concept: a glass porthole/lens ball set in a metal ring.
